title: The guard reads a guard path passed by name in a Python argv list, and reads node argv only in subprocess calls
why: Lane other-checkout-cp-own (session_013NEJL3R2CBFavz7grtbJY8), 11:53 CST Nov 8, two Low round-2 findings on #2125 (python-text-list-argv): (1) a guard path passed by name, `run([sys.executable, GUARD])`, is still refused; (2) the node argv read runs on any list argument, not only on subprocess calls. Stacked on #2125.
